input: grey crop of the detector box padded by 15 % of its longer side, resized to 64x64 (bilinear), ImageNet mean/std on 3 repeated channels
decoding: restricted to the fine ids whose training parent equals the detector's coarse class; below tau the stage abstains
evidence: Grok R3 E6-09: DEVCHECK fine macro F1 1.000 on ground-truth crops from synthetic-source Dataset PID sheets (saturated). No real-drawing evidence; not run on detector boxes by Grok.
limitations: Numeric Dataset-P&ID symbol ids only: their NAMES are unverified, so an id is shown as 'subtype proposal id N', never as a valve type. Trained on crops from synthetic-source sheets at their native scale; the app crops from a rendered page at a different scale. Not validated on any real drawing. PROPOSED only.
provenance: weights fine-tuned from torchvision mobilenet_v3_small ImageNet (BSD-3 code) on 9600 crops from PID2Graph Dataset PID (CC BY-SA 4.0, Sturmer, Graumann, Koch, doi 10.5281/zenodo.14803338) with fine ids aligned from a public Dataset-P&ID mirror; source: GROK_PID_READER_AUTOMATIC_OFFSHORE_RETURN_R3 results/E6-09
